svg.title: Aggressive: start as near the cell as the placement margin allows, shoot from beside its axis, park by the shortest way - RED alliance
svg.desc: Top view of the 141.35 by 141.35 inch BIOBUZZ field, audience at the bottom, red alliance on the left. Route partner_aggressive_rear_edge for the RED alliance, starting in tile B6, with 7 steps: 1 START at (32.5, 131.6, 90 deg); 2 DRIVE off the wall constant to 32.5, 123.0; 3 DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 51.3, 124.9; 4 WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 20.4 s on the route clock; 5 SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (51.3, 124.9, 100 deg); 6 DRIVE to zone linear to 12.5, 106.0; 7 PARK at (12.5, 106.0, 180 deg). First tip: partner tips first, assumed at 12.0 s; latest that works 19.9 s. Estimated 20.0 s, POLLEN balance -4, up to 8 points for our robot; 0 errors and 0 warnings.
svg.text: Aggressive: start as near the cell as the placement margin allows, shoot from beside its axis, park by the shortest way - RED alliance

g.title: step 2: DRIVE off the wall constant to 32.5, 123.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.1 s)
step 3: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 51.3, 124.9 (t = 1.1 to 2.5 s) - Turns 10 degrees on the way, so the back points at the cell from the left of its axis.
step 6: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.5, 106.0 (t = 18.0 to 20.0 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.

step 1: START at (32.5, 131.6, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Front edge ON the rear wall, facing it, as near the FLOWER as the placement margin allows: a hand that is 1 in and 3 degrees off still clears it on the first drive.

step 5: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (51.3, 124.9, 100 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 7: PARK at (12.5, 106.0, 180 deg) (t = 20.0 to 20.0 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 8.3 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 2.7 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).

step 1: START at (32.5, 131.6, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Front edge ON the rear wall, facing it, as near the FLOWER as the placement margin allows: a hand that is 1 in and 3 degrees off still clears it on the first drive.
step 2: DRIVE off the wall constant to 32.5, 123.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.1 s)
step 3: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 51.3, 124.9 (t = 1.1 to 2.5 s) - Turns 10 degrees on the way, so the back points at the cell from the left of its axis.

step 4: WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 20.4 s on the route clock (t = 2.5 to 12.5 s) - Waits for the CAMERA to see the rear cell up and steady (0.5 s), never for a time. 20.4 s on the route clock is the give-up time, the latest the rest of the route allows rounded down to a tenth: a partner that tips later gets no volley from us, the robot skips it and goes on to LEAVE and PARK.

step 5: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (51.3, 124.9, 100 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 6: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.5, 106.0 (t = 18.0 to 20.0 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.
step 7: PARK at (12.5, 106.0, 180 deg) (t = 20.0 to 20.0 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 8.3 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 2.7 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).

g.text: WAIT FOR TIP (give up at 20.4 s)
